questions.question: The standard deviation of a data is 2.8, if 5 is added to all the data values then the new standard deviation is ________.
questions.questionHtml: The standard deviation of a data is 2.8, if 5 is added to all the data values then the new standard deviation is ________.
questions.solution:
Properties of S.D:

• if we add, subtract any Number from each observation then S.D doesn't change

• if we multiply or divide by any number in each observation then S.D will change with same effect

So our answer will be 2.8 only.
